showTerminals.title: Show the terminals panel
showTerminals.description: When false, hides the xtralab Terminals (`xtralab-running-terminals`) tab from the sidebar.

showFileBrowser.title: Show the xtralab file browser
showFileBrowser.description: When false, hides the xtralab file browser (`xtralab:file-browser`) tab from the sidebar. The default JupyterLab file browser is unaffected.

showGitPanel.title: Show the Git panel
showGitPanel.description: When false, hides the `jp-git-sessions` (Git) tab from the sidebar.

showDefaultFileBrowser.title: Show the default JupyterLab file browser
showDefaultFileBrowser.description: When false, hides the default `filebrowser` tab from the sidebar. The xtralab file browser is unaffected.

showRunningSessions.title: Show running terminals and kernels
showRunningSessions.description: When false, hides the `jp-running-sessions` (Running Terminals and Kernels) tab from the sidebar.

showSearchReplace.title: Show search and replace
showSearchReplace.description: When false, hides the `jp-search-replace` (Search and Replace) tab from the sidebar.
